title: 第9章 城主夫人竟然是个大漏斗第10章 楚枫 她是我的女人
content_zh:
（）;
read2（）;楚枫深吸一口气，鼻尖萦绕着女子身上独有的馨香，混杂着玄阴之气暴走后溢出的淡淡冷意，让他心神微微一荡。
哪个干部经得起这样的考验？
就在此时，他的脑海之中响起裴玉涵清冷的声音。
“你就这么走了，她无法阴阳同济，必死无疑。”
闻听此言，楚枫的嘴角微微抽动了一下，脚步下意识地顿住。
他此行的目的本就不是救人，而是城主府豢养的那只四阶妖兽——天煞鬼虎。
四阶妖兽的实力与元婴境修士相当，只要他能以《御兽灵诀》控制住这只天煞鬼虎，就算王澶成功突破元婴境又如何？
到时候，他大可让这只狗贼，死在自己驯服的妖兽口中，一雪父母被杀的血海深仇。
更何况，王澶现在正是闭关冲击元婴境的关键时刻，根本无暇他顾。
紧接着，裴玉涵的声音再次响起，带着一丝循循善诱的意味。
“她体内玄阴果的力量霸道至极，却也精纯无比，对于你这纯阳之体来说，可是大补之物。
只要你将其炼化，不仅能化解她体内的阴气反噬，你的修为定能更上一层楼。”
话都已经说到这个份上了，楚枫哪还有不明白裴玉涵的意思。
他转头看向子书禾，随即抬手一挥，关上了房门。
一个时辰之后。
楚枫脑中一声轻响，壁垒碎裂。
金丹五重，水到渠成！
极阴灵体的身体像是一个巨大的漏斗，开始疯狂掠夺周围天地间的灵气。
不是吸纳给她自己，而是将灵力毫无保留地涌入楚枫的体内。

特殊体质自带独特的能力，可以加持修炼速度，或者拥有独特威能。
拥有特殊体质的修士，往往都是同级别的翘楚。
其中有一种特殊体质被称为炉鼎体质，就像赵雪莲的玄阴之体，比玄阴之体更加强大！
“没想到城主夫人是一个大漏斗……”
一日一夜。
当楚枫再次睁开眼时，天光已经透过窗棂，洒进了房间。
他体内的灵力愈发浑厚凝练，金丹五重的修为稳固无比，距离金丹六重，也只差了最后一线之隔。
炼化子书禾体内玄阴果的力量，不过用了一个时辰，可剩下的时间，却全都耗在了这女子身上。
子书禾原本清冷如秋水的眸子，还有几分难以言喻的水汽。
只差一点……她就能突破到金丹九重了！
可惜，昨夜炼化玄阴果的时候，终究还是遭到了阴气反噬。
子书禾微微转头，目光落在了床脚不远处，那颗滚落在地的头颅上。
王天福死不瞑目的眼睛，还死死地瞪着天花板。
紧接着，她又意味深长地看向楚枫。
“你比我想象的还要强硬。”
原本以为自己昨夜的清白会毁于王天福之手，却没想到关键时刻楚枫竟然冲了进来。
楚枫闻言，挑了挑眉。

read2(); Chu Feng took a deep breath, and the unique fragrance of the woman lingered on the tip of his nose, mixed with the faint coldness that overflowed after the Xuan Yin energy was violently released, which made his mind wander slightly.
Which cadre can withstand such a test?
At this moment, Pei Yuhan's cold voice sounded in his mind.
"If you just leave like this, she can't combine Yin and Yang, and she will definitely die."
After hearing this, the corners of Chu Feng's mouth twitched slightly, and his steps subconsciously stopped.
The purpose of his trip was not to save people, but to save the fourth-level monster raised by the city lord's mansion - the Tiansha Ghost Tiger.
The strength of the fourth-level monster is comparable to that of a Yuanying Realm monk. As long as he can control this evil ghost tiger with the "Spiritual Art of Controlling Beasts", what if Wang Chan succeeds in breaking through to the Yuanying Realm?
When the time comes, he can let this dog thief die in the mouth of the monster he has tamed, a blood feud in which Yixue's parents were killed.
What's more, Wang Chan is now at the critical moment of seclusion and entering the Nascent Soul Realm, and has no time to care about anything else.
Immediately afterwards, Pei Yuhan's voice sounded again, with a hint of persuasion.
"The power of the Xuanyin Fruit in her body is extremely domineering, but it is also extremely pure. For a pure Yang body like yours, it is a great tonic.
As long as you refine it, you will not only be able to resolve the backlash of Yin energy in her body, but your cultivation will also be able to reach a higher level. "
Having said this, how could Chu Feng still not understand what Pei Yuhan meant.
He turned to look at Zi Shuhe, then raised his hand and closed the door.
An hour later.
There was a soft sound in Chu Feng's head, and the barrier shattered.
The fifth level of the golden elixir is a matter of course!
The body of the extremely yin spirit body is like a huge funnel, and it begins to crazily plunder the spiritual energy from the surrounding heaven and earth.
Instead of absorbing it to herself, the spiritual power poured into Chu Feng's body without any reservation.
Special physiques bring unique abilities, which can increase the speed of cultivation or possess unique powers.
Monks with special physiques are often the best at the same level.
There is a special physique called the Furnace Physique, just like Zhao Xuelian's Xuanyin Body, which is more powerful than the Xuanyin Body!
"I didn't expect the city lord's wife to be a big funnel..."
One day and one night.
When Chu Feng opened his eyes again, the skylight had already filtered through the window lattice and spilled into the room.
The spiritual power in his body became more and more powerful and concentrated, and his cultivation level at the fifth level of the Golden Core was extremely stable. He was only one step away from the sixth level of the Golden Core.
It only took an hour to refine the power of the Xuanyin Fruit in Zi Shuhe's body, but the remaining time was all wasted on this woman.
Zi Shuhe's eyes were originally as cold as autumn water, but there was still a bit of indescribable moisture.
Just a little bit away...she can break through to the ninth level of the Golden Core!
Unfortunately, when refining the Xuanyin Fruit last night, the Yin Qi backfired after all.
Zi Shuhe turned his head slightly, and his eyes fell on the head that rolled to the ground not far from the foot of the bed.
Wang Tianfu's eyes were still staring at the ceiling.
Then, she looked at Chu Feng meaningfully.
"You're tougher than I thought."
I originally thought that my innocence last night would be destroyed by Wang Tianfu, but I didn't expect that Chu Feng would rush in at the critical moment.
When Chu Feng heard this, he raised his eyebrows.
